newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. corn shipments to Japan delayed - traders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn shipments to Japan delayed - traders.

text.p: Corn shipments for September from the U.S. Gulf to Japan have been delayed by up to two weeks as U.S. suppliers are putting off deliveries to get better prices, Japanese traders said on Friday.
"Corn loading at New Orleans is delayed by up to two weeks. This is not a serious problem yet, but we're carefully watching its development," a corn trader at a major trade house said.

A lack of enough old crop corn is also delaying prompt shipments. "We mix new and old crop corn to keep sufficient moisture during shipment. But historic-low grain stocks mean there is a lack of enough old crop," another trader said.
